findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The selector reads `project.json` from every second-level library directory before it checks whether a full run is needed. The shipped assistant module is an Nx workspace package with `package.json` files but no `project.json` files: its copy instructions are in `src/forge/templates/skills/agents/assistant-module/typescript/libs/assistant/README.md:10`.
Case: normal use - after a client adds that module, every base-selected check fails with ENOENT while reading `libs/assistant/contracts/project.json`, including checks for unrelated web changes.
findings.title: Functional: Accept Nx packages without project.json

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The selected run silently skips a project's tests whenever its `project.json` has no `test` target. Twelve shipped libraries, including `libs/auth/server`, have only a lint target, although `apps/web/vitest.config.ts:17` includes tests under every library and the full `test:hooks` command runs them.
Case: normal use - a client adds a failing `*.test.ts` beside auth server code. The affected check runs the API suite but never runs the new library test, so the pull request can pass while the full suite would fail.
findings.title: Functional: Run newly added tests in affected libraries

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test. `_adopted_files_after_sync` runs `forge sync` on a manually created `fix/agent-accounts-upgrade` branch (`tests/test_mcp.py:65-67`), which installs the pre-commit hook. The new commit has no Forge item state, so `src/forge/githooks.py:122-129` refuses it; the later push to main at line 152 is also refused by the pre-push hook. The same issue affects `tests/test_starter_tree.py:253`: its shared smoke helper copies initialized clients including `.git` and then commits on main, so feature and assistant smoke tests fail through the copied hook.
Case: normal use - the required starter proof runs in CI, and the live starter smoke runs on pull requests or nightly.
findings.title: Gate: The upgrade and live smoke proofs cannot commit through Forge hooks

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The full owner-approved item also requires that the log name those parts. `apps/web/vitest.config.ts:6,17` sets the Vitest root to `apps/web` and includes all library tests. Vitest 3.2.4 resolves this target's filter to `src` and matches it as a substring, so every included `libs/*/*/src` test also matches ([Vitest filter implementation](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/blob/v3.2.4/packages/vitest/src/node/project.ts#L467-L487)).
Case: normal use - a web-only change runs all four unrelated library test files; a shared-util change runs its test both through `@app/shared-util:test` and again through `web:test`.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test. The named proof checks web targets, the API test target, and the shared-util test command, but asserts no library lint target and does not check the core-server or history-server test targets. Its count of two printed `vitest run` commands also cannot establish that their test files are disjoint. The live selected case exercises only a web change; its full run uses the global lint and hooks commands.
Case: normal use - removing `@app/auth-server`'s lint target would leave the named proofs green while an affected auth change stopped receiving its library lint check.
